import os
import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression


def main():
    input_dir = "./input"
    train_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv")
    test_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv")
    sample_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission.csv")

    out_dir = "./submission"
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, "submission.csv")

    train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
    sample_df = pd.read_csv(sample_path)

    # Target
    target_col = "class"
    y = train_df[target_col].map(lambda s: 1 if str(s).strip() == ">50K" else 0).values
    X = train_df.drop(columns=[target_col])

    # Identify columns
    id_col = "id"
    feature_cols = [c for c in X.columns if c != id_col]
    X = X[feature_cols]
    test_X = test_df[feature_cols]

    # Split by dtype
    cat_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if X[c].dtype == "object"]
    num_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c not in cat_cols]

    # Preprocessing
    numeric_transformer = Pipeline(
        steps=[
            ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")),
            ("scaler", StandardScaler(with_mean=True, with_std=True)),
        ]
    )

    categorical_transformer = Pipeline(
        steps=[
            ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="most_frequent")),
            (
                "onehot",
                OneHotEncoder(
                    handle_unknown="ignore",
                    sparse_output=True,
                ),
            ),
        ]
    )

    preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(
        transformers=[
            ("num", numeric_transformer, num_cols),
            ("cat", categorical_transformer, cat_cols),
        ],
        remainder="drop",
    )

    # Model
    # Use a regularized logistic regression with good default for sparse one-hot.
    clf = LogisticRegression(
        solver="saga",
        penalty="l2",
        C=2.0,
        max_iter=300,
        n_jobs=-1,
        random_state=42,
    )

    # Validation: stratified split (with CV-style holdout via one fold)
    # We'll do a single stratified holdout split to satisfy "holding out part".
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    # Use first split as validation to keep runtime low and deterministic
    train_idx, val_idx = next(skf.split(X, y))

    X_train, X_val = X.iloc[train_idx], X.iloc[val_idx]
    y_train, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]

    model = Pipeline(steps=[("preprocess", preprocessor), ("clf", clf)])
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)

    val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
    print(f"VALIDATION_SCORE: {val_auc}")

    # Train on full training data
    model.fit(X, y)

    # Predict test
    test_proba = model.predict_proba(test_X)[:, 1]

    # Prepare submission
    # Match sample_submission format/ordering by id
    sub = sample_df.copy()
    # Ensure id alignment
    # sample_submission may already be in desired order; map by id to be safe.
    test_id_to_proba = dict(zip(test_df["id"].values, test_proba))
    sub["class"] = sub["id"].map(test_id_to_proba).astype(float)

    sub.to_csv(out_path, index=False)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    sample_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission.csv")

    out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, "submission.csv")

    train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
    sample_df = pd.read_csv(sample_path)

    target_col = "class"
    y = train_df[target_col].map(lambda s: 1 if str(s).strip() == ">50K" else 0).values
    X = train_df.drop(columns=[target_col])

    id_col = "id"
    feature_cols = [c for c in X.columns if c != id_col]
    X = X[feature_cols]
    test_X = test_df[feature_cols]

    cat_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if X[c].dtype == "object"]
    num_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c not in cat_cols]

    numeric_transformer = Pipeline(
        steps=[
            ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")),
            ("scaler", StandardScaler()),
        ]
    )

    categorical_transformer = Pipeline(
        steps=[
            ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="most_frequent")),
            ("onehot", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore", sparse_output=True)),
        ]
    )

    preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(
        transformers=[
            ("num", numeric_transformer, num_cols),
            ("cat", categorical_transformer, cat_cols),
        ],
        remainder="drop",
        verbose_feature_names_out=False,
    )

    # Updated: remove deprecated penalty usage and avoid warnings; also increase max_iter for convergence.
    clf = LogisticRegression(
        solver="saga",
        penalty="l2",
        C=2.0,
        max_iter=800,
        random_state=42,
    )

    model = Pipeline(steps=[("preprocess", preprocessor), ("clf", clf)])
